test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, what would be the letter on the opposite side of the letter 'A' ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df4c1bf4da3a713ccf4c2180841c36afdc4e908864e5deadbb739efc1718788.png]
solution:
The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aadc833e5220e3f7578383a14f057563d1922f2a734573fb87a2837d3b347e4d.png] 

 
 

 
 
Alphabet

 
 
 
Opposite Alphabet

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

 

Option (1) D → E is opposite to D.

**Option (2) C → A is opposite C.**

Option (3) B → F is opposite to B.

Option (4) F→ B is opposite to F.

Hence, ‘Option (2)’ is the correct answer.
